name: badge
useFor: Use green, red, blue, purple, gray or yellow for a status or tag (Active, Failed, Email, Signed, Draft, Pending). Use pink for a feature or role mark beside a label (BETA, ADMIN), success size lg with a filled check-circle for something granted (Included), count for an unread number, and size well for a status reading (Active on green, Idle on gray, Edge on blue). Default (purple) and destructive are for counts and errors.
constraints: More than three badges in a row
source: Console Badge theme and the rail's notification count; Figma 427:2715: the rail (BETA, ADMIN), Create Agent Identity (Included), Tunnel (Active, Idle, Edge)
title: Badge
description: 28px pills with 12px medium labels on light fills (green, red, blue, purple, gray, yellow), the pink plan mark, the green Included pill, the red unread count and the tunnel's status wells.
